levels.surface: أحمد بن عمرو بن السرح المصري

notes: Two taḥwīl branches with their own names; they meet only at ابن شهاب, so no shared tail is written.
«ابن ذؤيب» (branch 2) is not merged with «قبيصة بن ذؤيب» (branch 1), as the text names them.
«قال جاءت الجدة» is the saying of ابن ذؤيب; the Abu Bakr and Umar cases that follow are part of the same story under the same chain.
